popupElements.text:
The Housing Unit Impact value at this pixel is {Raster.ServicePixelValue.Raw}.  This value is a unitless index that integrates flame length probabilities, housing unit density, and the generalized susceptibility of homes to wildfire damage as a function of fire intensity. It does not include overall burn probability, which allows it to reflect the potential consequences (i.e. impact on homes) if a fire were to occur. 

To download the full data visit: Downloads

If a fire occurs at this pixel, and a home exists there, the potential for loss or damage is {Raster.raw_data} on a scale of 0 (no damage) to 100 (complete loss). This puts the pixel in the {Raster.Classname} percentile, compared to all pixels nationwide. This measure integrates flame length probabilities with the generalized consequences to a home on every pixel, but it does not include overall burn probability.

The wildfire risk to a home in this pixel would be at the {Raster.Classname} percentile, compared to all pixels nationwide. This measure integrated overall burn probability and flame length probabilities with the generalized consequences to a home on every pixel. For every pixel on the landscape, it provides a relative measure of risk to a home if one existed there.

expressionInfos.name: expr0
expressionInfos.title: National Risk Rank
expressionInfos.expression:
return When( 
Number($feature.RISK_NATIO, '##.##%') < 0.4, "low",
Number($feature.RISK_NATIO, '##.##%') < 0.7, "medium",
Number($feature.RISK_NATIO, '##.##%') < 0.9, "high",
Number($feature.RISK_NATIO, '##.##%') <1.1, "very high",
"n/a"
)
